rules.sentence: Dermatologists often recommend treatment, long-term follow-up, and preventive strategies to reduce symptomatic actinic keratosis and minimize the risk of their progression to squamous cell carcinoma.
Lesion-directed therapies focus on treating individual actinic keratoses.
Standard options include cryotherapy, curettage, or surgical excision.
These therapies are effective for targeting specific visible lesions.
